frequency_question: How often do highly contested, party-priority federal election bills pass the U.S. Senate when facing intense legislative friction and procedural hurdles like the filibuster?
membership_rule: Includes major federal voting/election bills championed by party leadership that reached floor consideration or serious caucus-wide whipping between 2011 and 2026. Excludes routine bipartisan technical adjustments or uncontroversial amendments.
